baslik: How One Wire Blacks Out a Whole Country
aciklama:
A single overloaded power line can plunge millions into darkness in minutes. Here is how a blackout cascades.

#shorts #engineering #science #electricity #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A single wire can black out an entire country.
The power grid is one giant connected machine.
Every line carries only so much before it overheats.
When one line trips, its load jumps to the others.
Now those lines are overloaded, so they trip too.
In seconds, the failure cascades across the whole network.
Millions of people go dark before anyone can react.
Restarting a dead grid can take days of careful work.
The whole system is only as strong as its weakest wire.
